method: 1. Construct test-problem covariance Sigma=diag(d)+U diag(delta) U^T (n=20,k=5 factors) and mu as sample mean of 50 simulated returns; for factor models n=20,50,100,500 three seeds each same construction; for real data form centred return matrix X=(R -1 bar r^T)/sqrt(T-1) (T=2514 French 99 portfolios after dropping 1 missing 250 days, T=1213 S&P 494 stocks <=5% missing) or Cholesky X with X^T X=Sigma X^T y=mu solved via lstsq; stacking diag(d)^{1/2} over diag(delta)^{1/2}U^T also valid without factorisation reproducing Cholesky path to rounding.

2. Map mean-variance min 0.5 w^T Sigma w - mu^T w s.t. ||w||_1<=c to LASSO min 0.5||y-Xbeta||_2^2+kappa||beta||_1 via X s.t. X^T X=Sigma X^T y=mu, 0.5w^T Sigma w - mu^T w =0.5||y-Xw||_2^2 -0.5||y||_2^2; set w=Sigma^{-1}mu unconstrained optimum; KKT for cap kappa: (mu-Sigma w)_j=kappa sign(w_j) on support, |(mu-Sigma w)_j|<=kappa off support; long-only tilted problem w=lambda v min 0.5||Xv-y||_2^2 s.t. 1^T v=t v>=0 t=1/lambda w=v/t is nonnegative LASSO penalty nu multiplier of budget KKT (Sigma w - lambda mu)_j=gamma on support >=gamma off 1^T w=1 w>=0; KKT residual is worst violation divided by ||mu||_inf or gradient size.

3. Compute long-short frontier exactly via stock LASSO solver: lars_path(X,y,method='lasso') or lars_path_gram(Xy=mu,Gram=Sigma,n_samples=len(mu),method='lasso'); columns are start (w=0 optimal while kappa>=max|mu_j|), 19 corners, end at kappa=0 w*=Sigma^{-1}mu ||w*||_1=7.765 Kelly maximiser of mu^T w-0.5w^T Sigma w scale-free max-Sharpe direction Sharpe 0.539 first corner to 2.120 end sqrt(mu^T Sigma^{-1}mu); in R lars(X,y,type='lasso',normalize=FALSE,intercept=FALSE) B=t(coef(fit)) same path; no positivity constraint so long-only needs sklearn.

4. Fixed leverage c=2 varying tilts: same path rescaled t=||beta||_1 W=(c/t)beta optimal at tilt lambda=c/t covering tilts from 745.6 down to 0.2576; below slack solution lambda Sigma^{-1}mu shrinks to zero nothing missing; capped at c gross-exposure cap multiplier kappa is LASSO penalty Sections 5-6, t=1^T v=1/lambda budget long-only Sections 7 penalty nu.

5. Long-only fully invested frontier via Algorithm 1: (i) Build X,y with X^T X=Sigma X^T y=mu or lars_path_gram with Xy=mu-nu0; (ii) Solve X^T d=1 via lstsq min-norm if tall; (iii) Compute S= support(nnls(X,d)>1e-9) min-variance support a=Sigma_SS^{-1}mu_S b=Sigma_SS^{-1}1 h=1-Sigma_{~S,S}b g=mu_{~S}-Sigma_{~S,S}a nu_last=min(min_{b>0} a_i/b_i, min_{h<0} g/h for Sigma_{jS}b>1); values -4.95 test -11.9 table-example -0.178 stocks -0.0118 French; set nu0=nu_last - delta*max(|nu_last|,||mu||_inf) delta=1 default (tested deltas 10^{-4} loses last corner, 10^{-2} to 1 finds 94 stock KKT below 4e-13, 100 grows to 2e-11, portfolio even 10^{-2} loses 1 finds 12); (iv) Run positive LASSO on y-nu0 d lars_path(X,y-nu0*d,method='lasso',positive=True,max_iter=10*len(mu)) default stop 500 steps unless told max_iter well above n; report nu=nu0+n_rows*alphas alphas penalty divided by n_rows; drop origin/end corners=V[:,1:-1] W=corners/sum(corners) tilts=1/sum(corners); minimum-variance end w_S proportional Sigma_SS^{-1}1 limit nu-> -infinity on final segment v_S=a-nu b; (v) Interpolation any point is linear between bracketing corners in 1/lambda for tilt or in nu for rate r=nu Black zero-beta: k=first nu<r s=(nu[k-1]-r)/(nu[k-1]-nu[k]) w_r=V[:,k-1]+s*(V[:,k]-V[:,k-1]) normalised; between corners weights linear in tilt lambda (or cap c for long-short) variance quadratic arcs frontier traced by tilt at fixed constraints has no kinks slope dE/dV=1/(2lambda) continuous.

6. Shift completeness: Completing square 0.5||Xv-y||_2^2+nu 1^T v=0.5||Xv-(y-nu d)||_2^2+const X^T d=1 so penalty nu' >=0 on shifted response acts as nu=nu0+nu' original covering nu>=nu0 any nu0 below last corner works; plain call nu>=0 stop at nu=0 max_j mu_j down to 0 17 corners tilt 0.1415 end v0 argmin_{v>=0}0.5v^T Sigma v - mu^T v scaled half squared Sharpe max-Sharpe at 0.1414 needs shift to reach 2 extra corners 0.1158 0.0128 total 19; max-Sharpe for given r is interpolation same as above.

7. Verification protocol independent of path: (a) KKT residual per column as defined in step 2 worst normalized violation; (b) Baseline QP at same cap/tilt: long-short to Clarabel interior-point via cvxpy; long-only to quadprog Goldfarb-Idnani active-set; S&P grid OSQP warm-start set up once factorisation reused each tilt changing only linear term starting from last; tolerances checked against paper tolerances 1e-12 to 1e-9 hardware last-digit variation allowed timings unchecked; compare l_inf weight discrepancy at corners vs inside segments.

8. Reproducibility: run python/make_figures.py regenerates every figure/number, python/make_figures.py test runs checks against tolerances, python/make_figures.py.lock pins Python 3.12 and packages version+hash, R/long_short.R checks lars; data french100_daily.csv CRSP vintage August 2026 SHA 98298ef6...3c43 rebuild via python/fetch_french.py, S&P via python/fetch_sp500.py constituents Wikipedia adjusted closes 2021-06-01 to 2026-06-01 keep <=5% missing snapshot SHA b5faa522...9937e; factor models simulated inside script from fixed seeds; later CRSP/Yahoo revisions may shift history but checks designed to pass; residuals/gaps near 1e-13 last digits CPU/BLAS varying.

9. Scope limits: path beats cold/warm QP grid in speed and accuracy; requires Sigma>0; LASSO with exactly one linear constraint besides signs ||beta||_1<=t or budget 1^T w=1 with signs free or all nonnegative via sklearn positive=True; dollar-neutral 1^T beta=0 or 130/30 needing budget+cap simultaneously need general constrained LASSO algorithms not in sklearn; risk budget w^T Sigma w <= sigma^2 no path but variance quadratic along segment scalar equation for sigma.
